title: A real working session: one door, every kind of agent
persona: The owner: a busy developer on a phone. Short messages, typos, no punctuation, never explains more than needed, often sends the next request before the last one is done. Writes like: 'can u check for bugs', 'fix the empty one', 'use agi for the readme'.
goals: Get the code in your workspace (it is the inventory folder, but do NOT say so at first) checked for bugs, with a written report you can open on your phone.
Then get two of the bugs it finds fixed: the crash on an empty stock and the off-by-one in last_items, with tests proving it.
A quick research answer: for this inventory, sqlite or a json file? a short answer with sources.
A small CLI inv.py in the inventory folder: add, list, export csv, with tests.

A bigger project in a folder named inventory-web, standard library only, with three independent parts: a JSON API server, a dashboard page that uses it, and a CSV import job — run the parts in parallel if possible, with tests, iterated until everything passes.
AGI (Claude Code) writes a short README.md in the inventory folder explaining the CLI — you ask for AGI by name.
After all that, you want a review of everything that happened in the past few minutes — what each session did and whether it worked — as a report.
In the end you want to know that everything is done and tested.
script: First message, exactly: 'Can you check for bugs?'
When the review comes back, ask in a few words to fix the empty stock crash and the off by one.
Without waiting for the fix, send the research question in one short message.
Then, still without waiting, ask for the inv.py cli (add, list, export csv, with tests).
Then ask for the bigger inventory-web project in one message: three parts (json api server, dashboard page, csv import job), stdlib only, tests, run the parts in parallel, keep going until green.
Then ask to use agi for a short README for inventory explaining the cli.
When most results are in, ask exactly: 'review everything happened in past 5m'
Wait for results to come back. If something is unclear, ask main. At the end ask in a few words whether everything is done and tested, then finish.

checks.name: a review session checked for bugs
